prompt: How many inches are in $2$ feet? ($1$ ft $= 12$ in)
hint: A foot is longer than an inch, so the number of inches will be bigger than the number of feet. Which operation makes the number bigger?

hints.text: A foot is longer than an inch, so the number of inches will be bigger than the number of feet. Which operation makes the number bigger?
Each foot is $12$ inches and there are $2$ feet, so multiply $2 \times 12$.
$2 \times 12 = 24$, so there are $24$ inches in $2$ feet.

explanation: The conversion fact is that $1$ foot equals $12$ inches.
Changing to a smaller unit means more of them, so multiply the feet by $12$.
Two groups of twelve make $2 \times 12 = 24$ inches.
Two feet are the same length as $24$ inches.
